records.title: HiSem: Hierarchical Semantic Disentangling for Remote Sensing Image Change Captioning
records.reason: HiSem addresses remote-sensing image change captioning with cross-temporal attention and hierarchical MoE routing; its experiments optimize visual change-description quality. The routing is task architecture, not a method for lowering LLM inference cost, memory, or latency.

records.title: Widening the Gap: Exploiting LLM Quantization via Outlier Injection
records.reason: The primary text demonstrates an outlier-injection attack that makes models behave maliciously after GPTQ/AWQ/GGUF quantization. It directly concerns the linked quantization family, but contributes an attack/security analysis rather than a quantization or inference-efficiency improvement; retain as borderline for the deployment-risk connection.

records.title: SHM-Agents: A Generalist-Specialist Integrated Agent System for Structural Health Monitoring
records.reason: SHM-Agents combines generalist/specialist LLM agents for structural-health-monitoring analysis. Its case studies evaluate engineering task completion and agent coordination, not model inference efficiency or serving.
